displayName: [PSH] Managed Lustre dependencies (PD / Compute Engine / VPC) in Lustre regions

conditions.displayName: New incident, or state/relevance change, on a Lustre dependency in a Lustre region

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="servicehealth.googleapis.com/Event" AND jsonPayload.@type="type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.servicehealth.logging.v1.EventLog" AND jsonPayload.category="INCIDENT" AND jsonPayload.impactedProductIds=~"SzESm2Ux129pjDGKWD68|L3ggmi3Jy4xJmgodFA9K|BSGtCUnz6ZmyajsjgTKv" AND jsonPayload.impactedLocations=~"(^|[^a-z0-9-])(REGION_REGEX)(-[a-z])?([^a-z0-9-]|$)" AND jsonPayload.relevance!="NOT_IMPACTED" AND (labels."servicehealth.googleapis.com/new_event"=true OR labels."servicehealth.googleapis.com/updated_fields"=~"'state'|'relevance'")
